figurative_meaning_en: lapse or disorder of memory, forgetfulness
example_sentences_in_bangla: বয়স বাড়ার সাথে সাথে তার স্মৃতিবিভ্রম ঘন ঘন হচ্ছে।
চাপের কারণে অফিসে স্মৃতিবিভ্রম হয়ে গেল।
example_sentences_in_english: With advancing age, his memory lapses are becoming more frequent.
Due to stress, he had a memory lapse at the office.
note: This idiom is commonly used in modern Bengali to describe temporary or age-related forgetfulness without any specific historical anecdote.
